predicate.label: population includes subgroup members
predicate.definition: Population X is explicitly described as including people of demographic subgroup Y.
includes: explicit population including people from Y
a stated subgroup among the described population
excludes: ordinary organizational membership or corporate ownership
inferring that every member of Y belongs to X
ambiguous: generic include with unclear demographic roles
unclear population versus person or organization
a subgroup attachment to another population
predicate.notes: This asserts textual inclusion of subgroup members in the population being discussed, not universal set containment Y subset X.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit population including people from Y; a stated subgroup among the described population; historical described populations. Excludes: ordinary organizational membership or corporate ownership; geographic containment alone; mere comparison, proximity, or interaction; inferring that every member of Y belongs to X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic include with unclear demographic roles; unclear population versus person or organization; a subgroup attachment to another population. This asserts textual inclusion of subgroup members in the population being discussed, not universal set containment Y subset X.

rationale: Population-inclusion family is the largest recoverable meaning: explicit include/among paths describe Westerners including Americans. Restaurant co-ownership and Farrakhan ideological leadership are distinct families. The predicate asserts inclusion of some subgroup members, not universal set inclusion; generic include with unclear roles remains ambiguous. Centrally approved narrow extension.
